comment: House index rows the member rule in members.mjs cannot resolve, by DocID. `bioguide` pins a filing to a Member; `exclude` leaves it out of the tables, with the reason. Each was checked by hand against the index and congress-legislators on 2026-11-18.

9110523.why: Paper PTR filed 2017-03-10 under FL11, two months after the filer's FL09 term ended; the index's district is not the seat held

8218652.exclude: The filer was never a Member of Congress (paper PTR, MN01, 2022)
